Multiplication Sign Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Multiplication Sign is 0215. Hold Alt, type 0215 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Multiplication Sign also has the Unicode codepoint U+00D7, so you can type it with Alt+215 on Windows, search for U+00D7 in macOS's Character Viewer, use × in HTML, or \00D7 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Multiplication Sign character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity × for Multiplication Sign, but the numeric form × is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type multiplication sign on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 2 1 5 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Multiplication Sign character (×) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type multiplication sign on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Multiplication Sign. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Multiplication Sign" and click the character to insert it.

How to use multiplication sign in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00D7"; ()
  • Python: \u00D7 or chr(0xD7)
  • JavaScript: \u00D7 or String.fromCodePoint(0xD7)
  • JSON: "\u00D7"
  • LaTeX: $\times$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Multiplication Sign?

The legacy Alt code for Multiplication Sign is 0215. Hold Alt, type 0 2 1 5 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type × without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ×, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+215 not work?

Alt+215 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Multiplication Sign?

The Unicode codepoint for Multiplication Sign is U+00D7. You can use this value in HTML as ×, in CSS as \00D7, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type × on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00D7, then click it.
